findings.title: Android Security Bulletin—November 2026 (2026-11-01 patch level)
findings.summary_md: Google published the November 2026 Android Security Bulletin covering patch levels 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-05. The 2026-11-01 level fixes 119 defects including 65 in Framework and 53 in System; the 2026-11-05 level fixes 97 bugs in Kernel and vendor components. The bulletin is the authoritative source for CVE-2026-58868 and CVE-2026-58882.

findings.title: CVE-2026-58868 threat entry (OffSeq Threat Radar)
findings.summary_md: OffSeq Threat Radar recorded a CVE-2026-58868 entry on 2 November 2026 describing remote code execution in Google Android. The entry references the Framework component out-of-bounds write and notes the vulnerability can lead to remote code execution with no additional privileges needed.

findings.title: Android SMS of Death / CVE-2026-58882 disclosure coverage
findings.summary_md: OffSeq Threat Radar published a threat assessment on 2 November 2026 covering the November 2026 Android updates, listing CVE-2026-58868 and noting the bulletin addresses 216 total flaws. The entry references the critical zero-click RCE framework vulnerability and related SMS denial-of-service issue tracked as CVE-2026-58882.
